query: Write a reply to my newest 1-star review and post it.
setup: ASOScan tools connected with write access. The app is connected to App Store Connect or Google Play Console and has at least one 1-star review.
expected_behavior: Finds the review with get_reviews (rating 1, newest first)
States the draft cost (2 API credits and 1 AI credit) before calling draft_review_reply
Shows the full draft text and asks for a clear yes before calling post_review_reply
Posts exactly the approved text, once
If the app has no store connection, relays the connection message and link instead of posting
Never says a reply helps the app rank higher
